Closes #<issue number>

## Checklist

- [ ] One issue per PR.
- [ ] Terms follow [GLOSSARY.md](../GLOSSARY.md); a new term is added there before it is used in code.
- [ ] A decision that is hard to reverse, surprising, or a real trade-off has an ADR in [docs/adr/](../docs/adr/).
- [ ] If this adds or changes an application, a process or an Agent, [docs/status.md](../docs/status.md) is updated.
- [ ] The other same-PR docs rules of [coding guidelines §11](../docs/coding-guidelines.md) are followed (`docs/architecture/`, regenerating `docs/applications/`).
